# Gemini deprecations > A made-up page in the shape of aistudio.google.com/docs/deprecations, for tests/check-043.test.ts (its title is the real page's, 0.4.4 R6). A "**deprecation**" is the announcement that we no longer provide support for a model. Once a model is "**shutdown**", it is completely turned off, and the endpoint is no longer available. ## Gemini 9 models {% id="gemini-9-models" %} {% table %} * Model * Release date * Shutdown date * Recommended replacement --- * `gemini-mini-a` * May 1, 2026 * May 1, 2099 * `gemini-mini-b` --- * `gemini-mini-c` * March 1, 2026 * No shutdown date announced * `gemini-mini-b` {% /table %} ### Deprecated models {% table %} * Model * Release date * Shutdown date * Recommended replacement --- * `gemini-mini-old` * May 1, 2024 * May 1, 2025 * `gemini-mini-b` {% /table %}
